subject: Film & Cinema
title: Elevated Horror: Art Meets Dread
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Elevated Horror: Art Meets Dread.

hook.text: Get Out used horror to dissect racism. Audiences laughed, cringed, and thought.

buildup.text: Recent horror films embed social commentary inside traditional genre frameworks.

discovery.text: Directors like Peele, Aster, and Eggers treat horror as serious artistic expression.

twist.text: Critics coined 'elevated horror' — a label many horror fans find condescending.

climax.text: Horror has always been political. The difference now is that mainstream critics finally notice.

punchline.text: Horror was always smart. Critics just caught up.

quiz.question: What does 'elevated horror' refer to?
options: Horror films with social commentary and artistic ambition
